title: Motion Intro
slide_intent: Teach designers to connect movement to the shopping and savoring experience before selecting a visual effect.
strategic_value: Instacart can carry the same framework from the static toolkit into how its communications behave.
demonstration: A large text statement on cream ties motion to the shop + savor framework. The page introduces an idea in words rather than showing a timed example.
practical_value: Use the statement to ask which part of the shopping or savoring experience a proposed movement supports.

content_islands.name: Introduction label
content_islands.spec: Set Motion Intro beneath the small running header.

content_islands.name: Framework statement
content_islands.spec: Place the large dark green statement in the left half and let the cream field provide a pause around it.
